title: Finish the deadweight cut: dead workflows, DIRECTION.md, the playbook, the red-team gate
problem: PR #8733 cut CLAUDE.md from 352 to 155 lines and removed stale rules (gh-pages hand publish, Hetzner deploys, the ventures/* auto-merge refusal), but left the largest steering files and some automation untouched. The owner, 2026-10-20: 'cut the deadweight in rules and processes ... respect the competence of the ai agent engineer', and 'what you don't complete leave as an action item for a later run.'
evidence: 13 files under .github/workflows/ name the retired cluster's IPs, HETZNER, k3s or self-hosted runners (grep -lE, 2026-10-20)
portfolio/DIRECTION.md: 873 lines, 49 dated references; PRODUCT_PLAYBOOK.md: 42 never/must/do-not words
land-your-work.md 166 lines against a 160 budget; steering.md 124 against 120 (promptctl.py measure)
promptctl.py validate fails CI when the redteam routing share leaves 5-10%; the change to a reported default was reverted pending the owner's explicit yes
change: (1) Delete or disarm the workflows that only served the retired cluster, after reading what each still does. (2) Cut portfolio/DIRECTION.md to what is true now, moving history to docs/history/. (3) Strip incident stories from PRODUCT_PLAYBOOK.md's definition of done. (4) Bring land-your-work.md and steering.md under budget. (5) Make run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes the one verify command and verify-and-merge.md's list a reference. (6) Only if the owner says yes: make the red-team 5-10% band a reported default in promptctl.py instead of a validate failure. (7) Fix the drifted byok.mjs copies in ventures/ats-resume-checker and ventures/persona-conversation-simulator (their tests fail on main).
